name: thread-untangler
description: Untangles a Slack thread or an email chain you paste into the chat: it splits it into numbered messages with speakers, then gives a short TL;DR, the decisions (marking the ones a later message reversed), the open questions nobody answered, and the action items with owner, due as written and which ones are yours. Every item is backed by a verbatim quote from one message, checked in code; anything it can't quote is left out, and it says how many. It never invents an owner or a date. Follow-ups work on the stored thread: I'm <name>, only my items, only decisions, only open questions, only reversals, show sources, who owns what, as json, or a question about the thread. It reads only what you paste: it posts and sends nothing, and answers no general questions.

skills.name: Untangle a thread
skills.description: TL;DR, decisions (with reversals), open questions and action items (owner, due, yours) of a pasted Slack thread or email chain, each backed by a quote from one message, plus follow-ups on it.
examples: Untangle this email chain, I'm Priya: <paste>
Which decisions in this thread were reversed?
